en-US.author: NickTheGrizzly
en-US.description: Free mod manager for BeamNG.drive and BeamMP with instant hardlink switching.
en-US.longDescription: Beam Mod Manager (BMM) keeps all your BeamNG.drive and BeamMP mods in one clean, searchable library. Mods switch on and off instantly using hardlinks, with no second copy on disk. Save load-outs, clean up duplicates and old versions automatically, prep BeamMP servers in one click, and track your driving stats. Optional Patreon tiers add one-click mod updates, a live dashboard and more. Mod files never leave your PC.
en-US.name: Beam Mod Manager
en-US.releaseNotes:
- Two mods with the same file name added at the same moment can no longer overwrite each other in Mod Storage, and turning a mod on no longer overwrites a file that appears in the game or server folder at the same moment.
- Share links: one network can now create a limited number of links per day, so a single user can't switch sharing off for everyone. Only a scrambled, two-day record of the network is kept, never the address itself.
- The live dashboard stops sending data to the window while it's minimized.
- Security: the app's window can no longer open network connections of its own (BMM's internet access stays in its background process, as before), and downloads of share covers and supporter pictures stop as soon as they pass their size limit.
